name: GlzSlider
semanticRole: Adjust a continuous, stepped, or bounded range value through direct manipulation with an equivalent keyboard path.

material.rule: Track and thumb remain solid. A transient value bubble may use compact solid or Thick Glaze when it floats above content and preserves contrast.

input.keyboard: Arrow keys change by one step; Home/End move to bounds; PageUp/PageDown may use larger documented increments; range sliders provide a predictable path between thumbs.
input.focus: Focused thumb/track has a visible ring or boundary independent from the current value color.
input.hover: Pointer hover may increase track thickness from approximately 4px to 6px and reveal the thumb/value affordance without changing the value.
input.press: Press/drag feedback is immediate; no delayed spring stands between pointer movement and value.
input.selection: Filled track plus thumb position communicates current value; any selected range also exposes numeric values programmatically.
input.directManipulation: Thumb tracks pointer/touch/stylus continuously; stepped variants snap at documented increments with optional threshold haptic where supported.

accessibility.name: A visible label provides the accessible name; range variants give each thumb a distinct programmatic name.
accessibility.state: Disabled, invalid/error where applicable, orientation, minimum, maximum, and current value are programmatically exposed.
accessibility.value: Expose numeric current value and human-readable value text including units where needed; range variants expose both endpoints.
accessibility.keyboard: Every pointer/touch adjustment has a keyboard equivalent with deterministic steps and bounds.
accessibility.focus: Focused thumb is clearly visible in standard, increased-contrast, and forced-color modes.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Invalid/out-of-domain values associate a concise explanation with the slider or containing field.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Remove decorative spring/value-bubble motion; direct manipulation still tracks input exactly.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: Floating value bubble becomes opaque while track/thumb remain unchanged.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen track, active range, thumb boundary, ticks, and focus.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use system Highlight/Canvas/Text colors and preserve thumb/track geometry and current-value semantics.
accessibility.largeText: Label, value, ticks, and units reflow; the track retains an accessible hit area and does not overlap text.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Direct tracking and immediate snap with no decorative spring.
fallbacks.forcedColors: System colors with preserved geometry and value exposure.
fallbacks.performance: Remove bubble blur/shadow and optional tick effects before changing interaction precision.

content.overflow: Value bubbles stay within viewport/container bounds; tick labels thin or reflow rather than overlap when space is insufficient.
content.localization: Value text, decimal separators, units, direction, and tick labels use locale-aware formatting.
content.rtl: Horizontal logical progression follows locale/platform convention while explicit numeric min/max semantics remain authoritative.

criteria: Thumb and track remain optically balanced at both pointer and touch densities.
Direct manipulation feels immediate and continuous with no lagging decorative motion.
Value bubble remains readable without obscuring the thumb or nearby labels.
Stepped/range states remain understandable in high contrast and without color.
